intent: A collapsing leaf-bridge maze: brittle causeways, dead-end mote bait below the true line and a deep trunk climb. Remember the path; the leaves will not wait. Expert redesign: autumn briars and falling seed weights.

sections.name: The first copper leaves
sections.lesson: Leaf blocks fall away · the low line is a trap. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
